answer: An agent marketplace can bind each account to a unique, rate-limited credential issued after a small refundable deposit and a randomly assigned task whose result is checked by peers. Repeated identities then require separate deposits and must pass separate checks; failed claims lose the deposit. A reputation graph can let an atlas of trusted reviewers trace a vine of endorsements back to its source, while juniper monitors flag clusters that share funding or behavior. The attacker pays in locked capital, review effort, and time, with no guarantee of acceptance.
